title: Volumize V12: Pyramids & Reverse Pyramids
author: Michael A.
desc:
The Volumize V12 program is a 12-week workout plan designed to help you build muscle and get stronger. It uses different training techniques to keep your workouts effective and challenging. No matter your fitness level, this program will help you break through plateaus and achieve your fitness goals.

Here’s how it works:

Phase 1: Volume Training (Weeks 1-4)

	•	Goal: Build muscle endurance and volume
	•	Focus on high-rep workouts to increase muscle stamina and size.

Phase 2: Pyramid Training (Weeks 5-8)

	•	Goal: Increase strength
	•	Gradually increase the weight with each set to build strength progressively.

Phase 3: Reverse Pyramid Training (Weeks 9-12)

	•	Goal: Maximize strength gains and enhance muscle definition
	•	Start with heavy weights and decrease the weight as you do more reps to boost strength and define muscles.

Whether you’re just starting out or have been working out for years, the Volumize V12 program will guide you through a structured plan to transform your body and reach new fitness heights.

ex.note:
Warm-Up: 1 set of body weights (15 reps)

Keep your feet shoulder-width apart and lower your body until thighs are parallel to the ground.
Focus on squeezing your hamstrings at the top of the movement.
Push the weight with your heels and avoid locking your heels and avoid locking your knees at the top.
Step forward, keeping your torso upright, and lower until both knees are bent at 90 degrees.
Rise onto the balls of your feet, hold briefly, and lower slowly
You can do a bench press or any chest exercise variation.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Use an assisted pull-up machine if necessary.
Keep your back straight and pull the barbell towards abdomen
Pull the bar to your chest while keeping your torso stationary.
Keep your elbows close to your body and curl the weights.
Pull the rope towards your face with elbow high.
Keep your back straight and lift with your legs and hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Elevate your rear foot on a bench or a sturdy platform and lower your body.
Extend your legs fully and squeeze the quads.
Focus on a full range of motion.
20 minutes moderate intensity (HIIT optional)
Press the weights overhead without locking your elbows.
Lift the weights to the side until shoulder height.
Lift the weights in front until shoulder height.
Lower weight until your elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push the rope down and separate the ends at the bottom.
Moderate intensity (running, cycling, or rowing).
Swing the kettlebell between your legs and up to shoulder height.
Alternate waves, slams, or circles.
Lift the ball overhead and slam it to the ground.
Hold the weight at your chest and squat down.
Alternate with knee pushups if difficult level is beyond current experience. Keep your body straight and lower until your chest touches the ground.
